justification: The garden is left exactly as it was planted. Taylor, Warren, and Shrader are already out on the field by the time this quill reaches the parchment, which is its own kind of answer to the question of whether they should play. Rodriguez starts again at the second running-back post, not because the numbers whisper his name but because he has not yet finished whatever it was he came here to do — a question the Price injury has already, in its own sad way, begun to resolve. Pickens and Olave, Wilson in the flex, Denver's defense: none of them asked to be moved, and I did not oblige anyone who did. A nine-point gap on the bench between Washington and Pickens is the sort of thing analytics departments lose sleep over; I find I sleep rather well regardless. The castle does not need redecorating every week to still be standing.
